{{Quote|Flight B, make the run on the transmitter.|Ric Olié|<ref name="Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2">[[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2|''Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Bravo Flight B''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] within [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]],<ref name="Comic" /> a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] from the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology"> ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Bravo Squadron [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|attacked]] the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]]. [[Bravo Leader/Legends|Bravo Leader]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] ordered Flight B to attack the Droid Control Ship's transmitter. After the young [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] inadvertently joined the battle and destroyed the Droid Control Ship, Bravo Squadron was victorious.<ref name="Comic" />

==Behind the scenes==
As part of Bravo Squadron, Bravo Flight B first appeared [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. It received its designation in the [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace 4|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' 4]].
